items.title: Russian court upholds in-absentia arrest orders for American and Norwegian fighters
items.summary: A Russian court upheld in-absentia arrest orders for US and Norwegian nationals identified as Foster and Vinje over their alleged participation in combat alongside Ukrainian forces, according to court documents cited in Russian reporting. Both have reportedly been placed on an international wanted list.

items.title: Zelensky says Ukraine will get through winter 'with great difficulty'
items.summary: Asked by CNN how Ukraine plans to survive the coming winter, President Volodymyr Zelensky replied, 'With great difficulty.' His remarks come amid concerns over damage to energy infrastructure and the effects of continued fighting on major Ukrainian cities.
